# Lovable Meme Kit

> A reusable component library and pattern playbook for building browser-based meme generators with TanStack Start, React, and Tailwind. Distributed on npm as `lovable-meme-kit`.

## Components

- MemeTitle — Hero title with rainbow or glow gradient variants
- ImageDropZone — Composable upload surface with drag, drop, paste, and click
- ColorSwatchPicker — Background color row including a transparent checker swatch
- HowItWorks — SEO-friendly explainer section for the bottom of meme pages

## Helpers

- memeHead() — Returns a complete TanStack route head() with title, description, OG tags, Twitter tags, canonical link, and WebApplication JSON-LD

## Links

- Showcase: https://memekit.lovable.app/
- Source: https://github.com/RomaLetodiani/lovable-meme-kit
